name: Donaria
tagline: Corporate-grade swag, sourced and shipped like clockwork.
positioning: Donaria is the merchandising platform that lets individuals and small teams order, warehouse, and ship branded swag with enterprise-grade logistics.

hero.h1: Swag operations, standardized end to end.
hero.sub: From the first mockup approval to the tracking number in your inbox, Donaria runs your branded merchandise like a supply chain — not a scramble of email threads.

features.title: Managed inventory
features.description: Warehouse your hoodies, bottles, and notebooks in our climate-controlled facilities and draw down stock on demand — no garage full of leftover totes.

features.title: On-demand fulfillment
features.description: Ship one gift box or five hundred kits from a single dashboard, with real-time tracking and address collection links for every recipient.

features.title: Brand asset lock
features.description: Upload your logo once and lock approved colors, placements, and Pantone values so every reorder matches the last one exactly.

features.title: Proof approvals
features.description: Review digital mockups and physical samples in a threaded approval flow, with sign-off timestamps kept for every SKU you produce.

features.title: Global sourcing
features.description: Tap a vetted network of manufacturers across three continents with lead times, minimums, and margins surfaced before you commit.

features.title: Spend reporting
features.description: Export line-item cost breakdowns by campaign, team, or recipient — the receipts finance actually asks for at quarter close.

testimonials.quote: We used to run new-hire kits off a spreadsheet and a prayer. Donaria turned it into a repeatable process — every recruit gets the same box in three days flat.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: The brand asset lock alone paid for itself. No more off-color mugs showing up at conferences with a stretched logo on them.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delacroix

testimonials.quote: I'm a team of one running merch for a 40-person startup. Donaria gives me the logistics muscle of a company ten times our size.
testimonials.name: Elena Fitzgerald

pricing.blurb: For individuals and side projects putting their name on real things.
For small teams shipping swag on a recurring schedule.
For organizations standardizing swag across every department.

homepage.footerBlurb: Donaria is the operations layer for branded merchandise — sourcing, storage, and shipping for the people who put logos on good things.
